observations: The page number «36» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01: «(= leer, Null)» continues «ob dies mit ṣifr» at the end of p. 35 (JP2 0067, L37): the name of the Spanish era, «ṣufr», and «ṣifr», empty, zero. L10 and L31: the headings of chapters 3 and 4, in bold, centred, each followed by the reference to the text, centred.
L28: the note number 4 stands twice, after «minutae» and after «secundae»; the note explains both. L32: «2—2b», the b raised; L34: «159r», the r raised.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Ideler», «wir» (L18, for emphasis), «Dozy»; italics: the Latin and Arabic words and the titles. The transliteration: «mabsūṭ» (L17), «daḳīḳa», «daḳā’iḳ» (L23), «thāniya», «thawānī» (L26-L27), with the dots under ṭ and ḳ and the macrons as printed; N02 «ṣafar», «aṣfar».

N05: «zu partes» and «secundae.» are printed heavier than the rest of the line; their strokes measure 5-5.5 px where the other words of the line measure 4-5 px, a difference of inking, not of type; transcribed in the type of the line.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (8-11 px measured).
